title: Small shops recommend like it's 2010.
sub: Bought a kettle? Here's another kettle.
vo: Small online shops can't recommend like Amazon. They don't have millions of orders, so their plugins just suggest more of the same. Buy a kettle, get offered another kettle.

title: Affinity Cart
sub: Cross-selling by taste for WooCommerce, powered by the Qloo taste graph.
vo: Affinity Cart is a WooCommerce plugin that recommends through taste instead of sales history. It uses Qloo's taste graph to understand what a shop's customers love, across music, film, books and brands, and turns that into sales from the very first order.

This is Nordvik, a demo store running on real WooCommerce. A first-time visitor from Bilbao already gets picks for their taste, marked right in the catalog. No account, no history. Just their city, and Qloo.
Change the city, and the shop changes with it. People in Berlin lean a little differently, and Qloo knows it.

On a product page, Complete the vibe recommends across categories, and says why. Bon Iver fans also love Fjällräven and Polaroid. Then there are kits: three products the same kind of person loves, ten percent off together.
Shopping for someone else? The gift finder asks what they love. A Claude agent looks that taste up in Qloo, and picks only from what this shop has in stock.
Checkout is plain WooCommerce. Every item that came from Affinity Cart is tagged all the way to the order line.

So the merchant sees exactly what Affinity Cart sold, split by source. With autopilot on, it keeps itself current: after new orders it re-reads the store and rewrites cross-sells and kits in WooCommerce on its own.

Under the hood, an agent translates every product into Qloo: the album, the book, the game, or the interests behind it. Hiking boots become hiking, outdoors and nature. Every request to Qloo is right there to inspect.
Customers are grouped into tribes by taste, with what else they love: brands, artists, films. Export a tribe for a campaign, and the emails never leave WordPress.
And the ghost catalog: what your own customers would buy, if only you sold it. One click turns it into a draft product.

title: Affinity Cart
sub:
Taste-based cross-selling for WooCommerce, from the first order.
Qloo + Claude. Shopify next.
vo: Affinity Cart. Cross-selling by taste, for every WooCommerce shop, from the first order.
